i.norm: Reads the private {@code tags} map of a TagSet via reflection and returns how many namespaces it currently holds. The map is keyed by namespace, so its size equals the number of namespaces that have had at least one tag added to them.

A copy made via {@code new TagSet(source)} resolves unknown tags lazily by pulling them through from its own root source. Looking up a tag on the copy must therefore not add any entries back into the original source TagSet.
Trigger a lazy pull-through lookup on the copy, not on the source.
